description: Client-side script defining a custom report 'Supplier Quotation Comparison' in Frappe/ERPNext, including filters, formatting, and a dialog for setting default suppliers.

methods.name: formatter
methods.description: Custom formatter for report cells, highlighting expired or soon-to-expire valid_till dates and minimum price per unit.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initializes report, adds button to open default supplier dialog.

methods.name: make_default_supplier_dialog
methods.description: Creates and shows a dialog to select and set a default supplier for an item.
